name: forgium
description: Repository-native workflow engine for software development agents.

scripts.test:e2e:product: npm run build && FORGIUM_E2E_DIST=1 vitest run src/core/__tests__/product-loop-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:implementation: npm run build && FORGIUM_E2E_DIST=1 vitest run src/core/__tests__/implementation-observation-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:implementation:pi: npm run build && FORGIUM_E2E_PI=1 vitest run src/core/__tests__/pi-spec-flow-implement-e2e.test.ts --testTimeout=150000
scripts.test:e2e:real: npm run build && vitest run src/core/__tests__/real-run-e2e.test.ts --testTimeout=30000
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build && FORGIUM_E2E_PI=1 vitest run src/core/__tests__/pi-spec-flow-implement-e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=180000
scripts.test:e2e:offline: npm run build && vitest run src/core/__tests__/cli-contract-e2e.test.ts src/core/__tests__/watch-cli-e2e.test.ts --testTimeout=60000
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && git diff --check && npm run test:e2e:real
